faqs.question: Can I use this anti hair thinning DHT blocking shampoo every day?
faqs.answer: You shouldn't shampoo your hair more than once every 2 days. Over shampooing your hair leads to damaging your follicles and a dry scalp.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects to this DHT blocker shampoo for men?
faqs.answer: Absolutely not. This anti hair thinning shampoo has no side effects and is extremely safe for application.

faqs.question: How can I stop hair thinning immediately?
faqs.answer: There is no product in this world that stops hair thinning immediately. You have to follow a proper regime, maintain a proper diet and keep your scalp free of impurities.

faqs.question: What is a DHT Blocker?
faqs.answer: DHT is a natural hormone found in everybody responsible for hair thinning. For most of us, our body starts producing excess DHT which usually accumulates at your hair follicles and prevents hair from getting adequate blood flow and nutrients. This causes hair to thin and eventually snap off.DHT blockers like caffeine slow down DHT production in the body. In doing so, DHT Blockers enable a healthy growth of hair follicles.

faqs.question: Why do I need biotin for hair?
faqs.answer: Biotin is also known as vitamin B7. When used on hair, it helps stimulate follicles and promote hair growth. It results in visibly thicker hair.
